time_basis: DATE-AVG / MJD-AVG (mid-exposure) from the IMAGE header
wavelength_location: Catalog-predicted position of Barnard's Star at this observation time
wavelength_method: WCS-WAVE (-TAB) bilinear lookup at the checked source pixel; SIP not applied to the spectral WCS; no extrapolation

image.encoding: 8-bit grey + alpha; alpha 0 where off-image or non-finite

registration.projection: TAN (gnomonic) tangent at the grid centre, ICRS
registration.pixel_convention: x right, y down from the top-left image corner; pixel (i, j) spans [i, i+1) x [j, j+1); the grid centre is (width/2, height/2)

display_wcs.note: FITS convention (+y north). PNG row r is FITS row n-1-r.

registration.method: Inverse mapping: each display pixel centre -> sky (display TAN) -> source pixel through the frame's TAN-SIP celestial WCS (astropy all_world2pix). Intensity: bilinear over finite neighbours. Flags and non-finite mask: nearest neighbour (bitwise OR over sub-samples if downsampling). Coverage: geometric (source pixel footprint).

notes: 3 non-finite IMAGE/VARIANCE pixel(s) in the screening circle (e.g. saturation); covered, but flagged.

display_scale.method: asinh: t = clip((v - lo) / (hi - lo), 0, 1); grey = 255 * asinh(t / 0.1) / asinh(1 / 0.1)
display_scale.basis: percentiles 0.5-99.5 of the pooled finite native pixels inside the display grid of 2025W35_1A_0008_1_D3, 2026W12_1A_0610_2_D3, 2026W34_1A_0431_1_D3 (case moving_neighbor)
display_scale.background_method: median of this frame's finite IMAGE pixels (single number; no spatial background model)

marker.label: Barnard's Star
marker.explanation: Catalog position propagated with proper motion, parallax distance and radial velocity to this frame's mid-exposure time. A finder aid, not a detection. Annual parallax is not modelled.

acknowledgments: This product uses data from SPHEREx, a NASA mission managed by JPL/Caltech, obtained from the NASA/IPAC Infrared Science Archive (IRSA).
provenance.retrieved_at_note: Creation time of the local download manifest for this cutout batch.

limitations: Display pixels (1.41 arcsec) are resampled from ~6.15 arcsec native pixels; resampling adds no resolution.
Wavelength is the WCS-WAVE lookup-table value at the checked position only; it varies across the image, and the supplement describes this table as an approximation for visualisation.
Quality screen = flags and non-finite pixels within 2.5 native pixels of the checked position. Not a detection, photometry or astrometric validation.
The marker is a catalog prediction, not a measured position.
